what: Why rcmdcheck is slow, and what changes
title: Fast, Parallel, Cache-Aware R CMD check for CI
text: rcmdcheck() , serially: R CMD build: installs package (compile #1) build vignettes (vignettes run #1), builds PDF manual (LaTeX). R CMD check: installs package tarball (compile #2, serial make, cache), runs ~50 static checks, examples, whole test suite one process, rebuilds vignettes (vignettes run #2) PDF manual . C++/Rust code gets compiled twice per run scratch every CI run. Rust crates (lto = true / codegen-units = 1, common templates) dominate many check runs. fastcheck() : Static checks, test shards, example shards vignettes run time one process pool (jobs, default: cores). result errors, warnings notes like rcmdcheck, plus checks data frame, timings log directory.

text: profile = "faithful" (default): R’s compiler flags untouched, install log compiler warning checks R CMD check. speedups structural (one compile, parallel make, caching, concurrency). profile = "fast": also compiles C/C++ -O0 -g0 Rust lto=false, codegen-units=256, opt-level=1 (CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_* env vars, override Cargo.toml). Much faster cold builds heavy C++/Rust; meant PR CI. Optimisation-dependent warnings (e.g. -Wmaybe-uninitialized) can missed, keep faithful job main releases.

what: Fidelity: what is (and isn’t) identical to R CMD check
title: Fast, Parallel, Cache-Aware R CMD check for CI
text: static checks R’s R CMD check code (--install=check: mode CRAN uses already-installed packages). Test failures, example errors vignette errors reported ERROR. Examples: per-topic timings --timings output produced, Examples/*.Rout.save comparisons done. Vignettes woven (code runs) tangled/re-run separately, inst/doc consistency checks R CMD check skipped (--ignore-vignettes). testthat shards run separate processes. Tests depend running another file process (state leaking files) can behave differently. Tests write fixed paths inside tests/ fine (shard copy); tests writing fixed paths elsewhere (e.g. ~) may collide. PDF manual skipped unless manual = TRUE / --manual. Rd checks (checkRd, codoc, usage, cross-references, missing docs) still run. _R_CHECK_SYSTEM_CLOCK_ defaults FALSE. ---cran, R otherwise asks three internet time servers current time, one another, catch machine whose clock wrong. servers can’t reached (common CI behind firewalls), one can take 60s failing, check still ends “NOTE: unable verify current time”. default, future file timestamps check still runs, compares system clock (NTP-synced GitHub runners). Set _R_CHECK_SYSTEM_CLOCK_=TRUE get R’s behaviour back.

Install ccache (apt-get install ccache) , Rust packages, sccache. action . Package dependencies still installed r-lib/actions/setup-r-dependencies (already caches). Rust: saved target/ dir reused package’s Makevars builds src/<crate dir>/target (default layout rextendr / savvy / “hellorust” templates). Makevars deletes target/ building (CRAN-oriented templates NOT_CRAN unset), sccache helps.
